summary: DoRaa Sangam House is a React + TypeScript single-page luxury storefront with a cinematic dark ocean theme (canvas backgrounds, pearl/gold accents, premium motion design) and a frontend-first commerce experience. It ships a curated dummy catalog and an elevated Banarasi saree showcase that is being expanded toward ~150 products with auto-grouped creative collections, category slider sections, and highly animated product cards (mannequin-style display, hover glow/micro-interactions, quick-details overlays), while preserving the existing quick view, PDP overlay with zoom gallery, wishlist, add-to-cart micro-interactions, and guest checkout flow. Optional Internet Identity authentication remains for ICP readiness (backend is currently a stub canister).

existing_features.title: Minimal ICP Motoko backend canister stub
existing_features.description: Provides a single public method confirmDesignPreview(): async Text returning a static confirmation string; no commerce endpoints are implemented.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication provider and hook
existing_features.description: Implements login/logout, persisted identity loading on mount, and a detailed loginStatus state machine with delegation validity checks and configurable derivation origin.

existing_features.title: Identity-aware backend actor creation and caching
existing_features.description: Creates an anonymous actor when unauthenticated and an identity-bound actor when authenticated; caches by principal and invalidates/refetches non-actor queries when the actor changes.

existing_features.title: App bootstrap with theme, providers, and global layout
existing_features.description: Bootstraps React Query and Internet Identity providers, applies dark theme via next-themes, wraps the app in CommerceProvider, and renders global background, header/footer, section pages, chat widget, and toast system.

existing_features.title: Centralized brand identity constants
existing_features.description: Exports brand name and static asset paths (logo mark, favicon, bot avatar) for consistent usage across the app.

existing_features.title: Dummy product catalog including 30 Banarasi static images
existing_features.description: Provides a frontend-first catalog including non-Banarasi items and a 30-product Banarasi saree collection with rich metadata (images arrays, ratings, swatches, fabric/pattern text, COD/express flags, optional sizes, blouse suggestions).

existing_features.title: Banarasi categorization layer (7 creative collections)
existing_features.description: Defines a typed registry of uniquely named Banarasi categories with descriptions and cover images; each Banarasi product is assigned exactly one primary category via banarasiCategory.

existing_features.title: Home/Collections Banarasi category showcase with scroll-triggered reveal
existing_features.description: Renders a premium grid of Banarasi category cards with lazy-loaded cover images, product counts, wave/gold styling, and scroll-triggered reveal animations; integrates with the cinematic dark luxury theme and reduced-motion preferences.

existing_features.title: Interactive Banarasi category carousel overlay
existing_features.description: Clicking a category opens a modal overlay containing a looping horizontal carousel of products for that category with arrows and premium styling; integrates Quick View and Product Detail overlays and updates dynamic metadata while open.

existing_features.title: Products/Collections page with masonry grid and optional infinite scroll

existing_features.title: Premium product card with hover micro-interactions and mannequin-style motion cues
existing_features.description: Displays product imagery and metadata with luxury hover lift/glow, lazy-loaded image fade-in, quick view action, click-to-detail behavior, and bottom action row; Banarasi cards show fabric badge and can display a rich quick-details overlay on hover.

existing_features.title: Wishlist support (localStorage persisted)

existing_features.title: Banarasi quick-details overlay (premium mini-panel)

existing_features.title: Sticky luxury header with navigation, cart badge, and auth controls

existing_features.title: Scroll-triggered reveal animations with reduced-motion support

existing_features.description: Floating chat widget with session-based auto-greeting, message history, simulated typing delay, auto-scroll, and keyword-matched canned responses (no external AI/LLM).

existing_features.title: SEO-oriented dynamic metadata updates for SPA overlays
existing_features.description: Hook updates document title and meta description for views like Banarasi showcase and category carousel overlay, restoring previous metadata on cleanup.

existing_features.title: Luxury design system and Tailwind utilities
existing_features.description: Defines the dark luxury palette (pearl blue + gold), typography (Playfair Display + Inter), glow shadows, masonry utilities, shimmer skeletons, wave underline/wipe, checkout wave reveal, and reduced-motion overrides.

existing_features.title: Expand the frontend Banarasi saree catalog to approximately 150 products using the existing static image approach, and ensure the expanded catalog is fully integrated everywhere products are rendered (Collections page sections/sliders, product grids, quick view, PDP overlay, wishlist, and cart flows).

Implement an automatic Banarasi product grouping mechanism that assigns each product to a creative collection based on observable attributes (e.g., color family, pattern name, occasion tags, or filename-derived hints), producing collection names aligned with: Zari Legacy, Silk Symphony, Royal Motif, Blooming Banarasi, Midnight Elegance, Celestial Threads, Eternal Gold; and render separate sections/sliders for each resulting category.

Update the Collections/Products browsing experience so that category sections reveal on scroll with a gold wave transition between sections, and each category is presented as a horizontal slider/carousel supporting arrows and dot navigation and an optional auto-swipe/autoplay mode (with reduced-motion respecting system preferences).

Enhance the Banarasi product card visual treatment to consistently present each saree image as a mannequin/on-model-style display (using the existing placeholder/assumed-on-model treatment), including subtle hover spin/zoom and a fabric ripple effect implemented via CSS (or an animation library already present in the project), without introducing new unsupported dependencies.

Update product card hover micro-interactions to include: lift, pearl-blue + gold glowing border, slight scale-up, and a micro-ripple animation under the saree image; ensure the effects are performant and do not cause layout shift.

Upgrade the product card action row so the wishlist and add-to-cart icons are visually glowing and pulse on hover (gold/pearl-blue), and on successful add-to-cart trigger a “saree flows to cart” success animation that is clearly visible and ties into the existing cart icon/badge area.

Expand the Banarasi quick-details overlay on hover/click to include: color swatches, pattern name, fabric (English label: “Banarasi Silk”), price, a functional size chart dropdown/accordion, blouse pairing suggestions, gold star rating display, reviews count, share icon action, COD badge, and an express delivery tag (Myntra/Flipkart-style presentation) while keeping user-facing text in English.

Ensure product image click supports a zoom-lens style interaction and provides a clear navigation path to the full product detail view (PDP overlay) from each product card, preserving existing quick view behavior where applicable.

Polish the overall Banarasi showcase presentation to feel “ultra-impressive” with a consistently dark black background treatment, pearl shimmer particle ambience, gold wave transitions, and cinematic scroll reveals, while maintaining responsiveness and performance best practices.

Improve performance and SEO behavior for the expanded catalog by ensuring images are lazy-loaded and responsive, and product cards provide SEO-friendly metadata updates for overlay navigation (title/description updates) consistent with the existing SPA metadata approach.

architecturalNotes: React SPA built as scrollable anchor-linked sections (Home, Collections, Product, Checkout, FAQ, About) with modal/sheet overlays (Quick View, PDP, Cart, Checkout).
TanStack React Query is used as a lightweight client data layer (queries/mutations + cache invalidation), while actual commerce state is managed in a dedicated React Context provider.
Commerce is frontend-only: cart state is managed via CommerceProvider and persisted to localStorage; mutations call context actions and invalidate React Query caches for UI refresh.
ICP authentication is integrated via an InternetIdentityProvider using @dfinity/auth-client; an identity-aware backend actor is created and cached via React Query (anonymous vs authenticated).

Cinematic visuals are implemented using fixed-position canvas renderers (OceanBackground and hero layers) plus Tailwind-driven micro-interactions; motion is consistently gated by prefers-reduced-motion.
UI uses Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui primitives; design tokens are driven via CSS variables (OKLCH) with next-themes handling dark mode.
knownIssues: Backend canister (backend/main.mo) is a stub with only confirmDesignPreview(); no product/cart/order/user APIs exist, so all commerce is client-side and non-authoritative.
Orders are not implemented: useGetOrders() returns an empty array and useRegisterUser() is a no-op; invalidating the 'orders' query has no functional effect.

Type/model mismatch: frontend domain types use bigint for ids/prices/quantities, while the dummy catalog and CommerceProvider use string ids + number values; bridging conversions exist and may cause future integration friction.
React Query cart queryKey is ['cart', cart] (includes array reference), which can cause cache churn; invalidation calls use ['cart'] which may not precisely target all cart-key variants.
frontend/src/components/SangamBackground.tsx is present but empty (implementation drift vs summaries/reference docs).

Two global stylesheets exist (frontend/index.css and frontend/src/index.css) with different token sets; the app imports src/index.css, but the extra file can confuse maintenance or accidental inclusion.
useCinematicSlider uses NodeJS.Timeout typing for a browser timeout ref, which can conflict depending on TS lib settings (setTimeout returns number in DOM typings).
OceanBackground reduced-motion mode draws a single static frame and returns; on resize it may not redraw for reduced-motion users unless the component re-mounts.
Banarasi quick-details overlay includes a 'Size Chart' button without a wired action (placeholder behavior).
Some files include unused imports/vars (e.g., BanarasiCategoryCarouselOverlay imports icons that are not used), which may trip lint rules.
